rows.en: The Naager bunch broke into the Far East Base! Anne's in serious trouble!?
Hey, Taki! We got word here too! We were all just talking about it.
The Desper Army has the Far East Base surrounded! They must be up to something!

…!?

Mr. Arai!
Mm… The Desper Army must be behind the Plus Ray business.
So you came, Goro Watari!
Boiler Desper! Where's the Plus Ray!?
Heh heh heh… Too bad, it's already too late! The time bomb device goes off in a few minutes!
Boiler Desper! I won't forgive you!
Kiriyama… I've had the space rocket "Otori" prepared! It can launch at any time…
Sir…? The "Otori," mankind's first Venus rocket? What on earth would we use it for?
Kiriyama… The Director is in a painful position too! Please, try to understand.

…!?

You don't mean…? Anne…?
Officer Yuri is also the granddaughter of Dr. Genzaburo Yuri! We too want to do everything we can, but…
I'm sorry, Kiriyama… But please, understand! This is the only way!
What did you say!? You want us to put Anne on the "Otori" and dump her in outer space!?
No… I did argue hard against it, but…

It's all right…

If I stay, I'll only be a burden to everyone…
Anne…
Damn it…
Furuhashi! Where are you going?
Isn't it obvious!? I'm going to grab this Plus Ray thing and bring it back!
I'm coming too!
Me too…
Dan! What about you…?

I want to stay by Anne's side!

Furuhashi, Soga, Amagi… I believe in all of you, and I'll be waiting!
But one wrong move, and you'll be…
I don't care…

Dan…!

Don't worry! We're not coming back empty-handed, that's a promise! All right, let's go!
All riiight, just you watch…
Nngh… The Plus Ray… the Plus Ray is… Uwooooh!

We did it!

There's still time! Recover the Plus Ray at once!
Right!
Mm…
All right…

Udesper!?

No, it's different…?

Udesper!?

No, it's different…?

Udesper!?

No, it's different…?

We are robot fighters, built by boosting the Udesper circuit even further!

Listen well, [VAR6]! This is Udesper Alpha… and I am Udesper Beta!
Udesper Alpha, Udesper Beta?
Udesper Alpha, Udesper Beta?
Udesper Alpha, Udesper Beta?
Here we gooo!
They're strong… Even stronger than Udesper!
They're strong… Even stronger than Udesper!
They're strong… Even stronger than Udesper!
Time we finished this, don't you think?
Finish us? A special move!?
Finish us? A special move!?
Finish us? A special move!?
Cross Hurricane… There's a vacuum inside the whirlwind! What an incredible special move!?
Cross Hurricane… There's a vacuum inside the whirlwind! What an incredible special move!?
Cross Hurricane… There's a vacuum inside the whirlwind! What an incredible special move!?

At this rate, they'll finish me off!

Zeber! Teleportation!
Damn… He got away!
Now we know what [VAR6] is capable of! He's no match for us after all… Cross Hurricane is invincible!
Find him! [VAR6] is mine to kill! I'll take him down, I swear it!
Some crazy guys showed up… It's like fighting four Udespers.
Still, it's good news, right? They say Anne's safe…
All the same… I never thought the Naager would come barging in themselves…
But… what were they doing in the Far East Base's Radio Control Room?
The Radio Control Room?
Hmm… That does bother me a bit. Maybe I'll look into it…
Still, I'm glad it worked out!
Thank you, everyone…
Aw, come on… When you say it like that, I can't help getting embarrassed.

Captain… Message from the Mars probe satellite!

It reports detecting an abnormal gravitational distortion near Mars!
A gravitational distortion? What on earth is happening!?

Unknown…

…!?

The probe is transmitting images!

Putting them on the screen!
What is this!?
What a terrifying sight…
What!? What's happening!?
A tornado! A huge tornado appears to have formed around the base…
A huge tornado? A natural phenomenon!?
Heh heh heh… So the test of Operation Multi-Hurricane was a success?

Of course, sir.

The Cross Hurricane current released from the hands of both staff officers, Udesper Alpha and Udesper Beta, is caught by the Far East Base's long-range radar,

then amplified a hundred thousand times by the special device we planted in the Radio Control Room. With that power, any great city can be turned into a desert of death in a single night…
Heh heh heh… With this, Tokyo will be wiped out! You've been a great help to me.

Not at all…

We are merely here to lend a hand. The operation's success is entirely thanks to your power, Fuhrer…
Mm… Carry out Operation Multi-Hurricane at once!

uncertain: U09699: narration-kind row is the body of a speech with no speaker (page 1 seems lost); from U09700 it is Kazuya Taki on the line to Tobei. Written as speech.
U09709: はあ… read as Kiriyama's puzzled "Sir…?" rather than an agreement.
U09747-U09749: トドメ echoed as "Finish us?" (repeating U09746's "finished this").
U09755/U09756: [VAR6] referred to as "he"; the hero inserted is Inazuman (Goro Watari, male).
U09757: 4人なった read as 4人になった "like fighting four Udespers".
U09775: 10百倍 read as 10万倍 (100,000x); 百 appears to be a misread of 万 (cf. B0131 U10490 高度6百5000メートル = 65,000 m).
omissions_kept: U09722: "Me too…" keeps the elided verb (Soga is coming too).

new_names.why: Inazuman's call, from the glossary attack Zeber Inazuman Flash
